prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / style-transfer. This is a production animation SPRITE SHEET, not a character redesign.
IMAGE 1 is the authoritative ORIGINAL hero design. IMAGE 2 is the freshly upgraded sculpted-3D rendering reference for this same hero. Preserve the original identity from image 1, and match image 2's premium soft 3D materials and lighting. Keep the original head/body proportions, exact face/eye shape and colour, ears/horns, markings, clothing, equipment and palette. No extra accessories or altered anatomy.
Output exactly TWENTY complete full-body frames in a strict FIVE COLUMN by FOUR ROW regular grid. Aim for 2560 x 2048 pixels (5:4 aspect ratio), with twenty equal square cells. Correct cell count and registration are essential. No text, frame numbers, grids, borders, scenery or floor.
GENUINELY TRANSPARENT ALPHA background; outside each hero alpha must be ZERO. No visible background, no checkerboard, no glow behind the hero, no cast shadows. Each hero entirely inside its own cell with 8% empty margins. Identical camera in every cell, three-quarter facing screen right, same character scale, no camera movement or zoom, common central anchor and feet at 94% cell height. Render the same hero consistently twenty times. Carefully separate neighbouring frames, including weapons, antlers, wings and tails.

IDENTITY LOCK:
Barratt is the original SMALL GOLDEN TAN DEER ARCHER: GREEN eyes, cream muzzle/inner ears, short branching tan antlers matching the original simple branching silhouette, golden forelock, green hooded cape hanging from shoulders (hood down), original brown leather tunic and gloves, crossed leather straps, rectangular brass belt buckle, brown boots, quiver with GREEN-fletched arrows behind shoulder, short curved WOODEN bow held LOW across his body. The bow shape and cape clasp must match Image 1. NO giant elaborate antlers, NO gold round chest medallion, NO altered white eyebrow markings. Signature action is drawing his original small bow with a green-fletched arrow; keep original face and equipment.
ANIMATION ORDER: four five-frame micro-sequences, one per row, progressing continuously left to right within that row. Every row begins and ends in the EXACT SAME neutral body pose to transition cleanly.
ROW 1, frames 0-4: natural blink in otherwise identical idle stance: eyes open, eyelids half closed, closed, half open, open. Body and hands remain registered.
ROW 2, frames 5-9: signature action: neutral, small wind-up, signature action extended, controlled recovery, exact neutral again. Keep feet planted; interpolate the arms and expression gradually.
ROW 3, frames 10-14: success: neutral, gentle smile, happy face and small celebration, settling, exact neutral. Keep identity, scale and planted feet unchanged.
ROW 4, frames 15-19: retry/thinking: neutral, gentle head tilt, thoughtful hand near chin, return halfway, exact neutral. Supportive expression, never frightened or defeated.
The row sequences must be animation in-betweens of one consistent model, not twenty different drawings/designs.
